notes: PeopleSoft Academic Advisement (AA) is the degree audit engine. It evaluates a student's completed coursework against their program's requirements and reports what's met, in progress, and still needed. The PS_AA_RQRMNT hierarchy is: Requirement → Requirement Group → Requirement Line → Course List. Institutions using third-party audit tools (DegreeWorks/Ellucian, CollegeSource TES) may have a parallel or replacement system.
